part.text:
Implemented Handlebars template engine and layout support. Summary of changes:

- **`src/templates.ts`** (new) — `TemplateEngine` loads `.hbs` templates from `./templates/`, layouts from `./templates/layouts/`, and partials from `./templates/partials/`. Pages select a template via frontmatter (`template:`), defaulting to `default.hbs`; layouts wrap output via `{{{body}}}`, defaulting to `base.hbs` (`layout:` overrides); partials are registered by filename (`{{> header}}`, `{{> footer}}`, `{{> nav}}`).
